name: visualneuroscience-app
description: The native shells for VisualNeuroscience.AI. The web app in ../site is the whole application; these wrap it for the App Store and Play Store without forking a line of it.

scripts.android: cap sync android && cap open android
scripts.ios: cap sync ios && cap open ios
scripts.android:apk: cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:bundle: cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
